standard.coverage: All employers regardless of size. The Fair Wage Act of 2023 ACCELERATED Maryland to $15.00 and abolished the old small-employer (14 or fewer) tier -- a stale table still carrying two Maryland rates is wrong.
standard.note: Md. Code, Lab. & Empl. 3-413. No escalator.

tipped.note: Maryland's $3.63 cash wage is set by statute and does not move with the standard rate.

youthAndTraining.label: Employees under 20, first 6 months
youthAndTraining.eligibility: 85% of the state minimum wage for the first six months of employment for employees under 20 -- Md. Code, Lab. & Empl. 3-413(g). 85% of $15.00 = $12.75.

knownGaps: Montgomery County and Howard County set higher local rates -- see local/MD-local-2026.json.
Maryland's separate agricultural and amusement/recreational-establishment sub-rates are not carried here.
